verdict: WMI returned `INVALID_NAMESPACE`. A namespace the client or MECM expected is missing from the repository. Usually `root\ccm` or a provider namespace.
fix: Confirm the missing namespace: `Get-CimInstance -Namespace root -ClassName __Namespace | Select-Object Name`. If `ccm` is absent, the MECM client WMI registration is gone - `ccmsetup.exe /uninstall` then `ccmsetup.exe /forceinstall`. If other core namespaces are missing, repair WMI: `winmgmt /salvagerepository`; escalate to `winmgmt /resetrepository` only if salvage fails.
